lines: # Folder map
What each folder is for. Read this before adding a file.
- `data/`: The dataset, by stage.
- `data/raw/`: Read-only images or text exactly as collected.
- `data/clean/`: Deduped, cropped, resized, filtered copies of raw.
- `data/captions/`: One .txt per sample, same basename as the sample.
- `data/reg/`: Regularisation or class samples.
- `data/splits/`: Train, val and test manifests.
- `data/rejected/`: Disposable removed samples plus a reasons log.
- `datasheets/`: Source, licence and consent record per data batch.
- `scripts/`: Dedupe, resize, caption, tag and split scripts.
- `configs/`: One training config per planned run.
- `base-models/`: Base weights or symlinks (ignored by Git); `sources.md` is tracked.
- `runs/`: One folder per run (`YYYYMMDD_name_vNN`), copied from `runs/_template/`.
- `runs/_template/`: Copy this to start a run.
- `runs/_template/checkpoints/`: Weights saved per step or epoch. Ignored by Git.
- `runs/_template/samples/`: Previews generated during training. Ignored by Git and disposable.
- `runs/_template/logs/`: Loss curves, tensorboard, stdout. Ignored by Git and disposable.
- `eval/`: Fixed tests applied to every candidate.
- `eval/prompts/`: Fixed eval prompts and seeds.
- `eval/samples/`: Eval grids per checkpoint, same prompts and seeds.
- `eval/reports/`: Comparisons and the chosen checkpoint with reason.
- `release/`: One folder per release (`v1.0`, `v1.1` ...), copied from `release/_template/`.
- `release/_template/`: Copy this to start a release (`v1.0`, `v1.1` ...).
- `release/_template/weights/`: Final weights file, the only weights in LFS.
- `release/_template/card/`: Trigger words, settings, licence, known limits.
- `release/_template/showcase/`: Curated outputs with their prompts.
- `cache/`: Latents, bucket and tokeniser caches. Ignored by Git and disposable.

purpose: `{{project}}` is a LoRA and model training workspace.
Start a run by copying `runs/_template/` to `runs/<run>/` and a release by copying `release/_template/` to `release/<version>/`.
rules: - Each folder's purpose is in `FOLDERS.md`; read it before adding a file.
- Never modify or delete `data/raw/`; cleaning writes new files to `data/clean/`.
- Every sample in `data/clean/` has exactly one caption file in `data/captions/` with the same basename.
- A removed sample is moved to `data/rejected/` with a one-line reason added to a reasons log in `data/rejected/`; never just deleted.
- Every run gets a new folder in `runs/` (copied from `runs/_template/`); never reuse or overwrite a run folder.
- Write one training config per planned run in `configs/`; copy it unchanged into `runs/<run>/` (keep its file name and extension) before training starts and do not edit it afterwards.
- Never change `eval/prompts/` or the seeds once the first run has been evaluated.
- Every checkpoint under consideration is evaluated with the full fixed prompt set, with grids saved in `eval/samples/` and comparisons in `eval/reports/`.
- Checkpoints stay in `runs/<run>/checkpoints/` (ignored by Git); only the final weights file in `release/<version>/weights/` is committed.
- Adding data from a new source needs a datasheet in `datasheets/` and approval.
- Creating a `release/` version (copied from `release/_template/`) or publishing weights needs approval.
- Run `git lfs install` once before the first commit.
